mapper.select: SELECT id, file_id, parent_id, node_index, level, title, heading_path, source_start_offset, source_end_offset, create_time FROM knowledge_outline_node WHERE file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY node_index
SELECT id, file_id, parent_id, node_index, level, title, heading_path, source_start_offset, source_end_offset, create_time FROM knowledge_outline_node WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT r.node_id AS nodeId, r.chunk_id AS chunkId, r.chunk_index AS chunkIndex FROM knowledge_outline_chunk r JOIN knowledge_outline_node n ON r.node_id = n.id WHERE n.file_id = #{fileId}
